title: feat(client): automation.*, actions.invoke and meta.getItem take an optional namespace and send the qualified address (ADR-0150 D5)
body: _Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4GmCm42LMfa6P1THG1vwU8)_ Fixes #31695 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none Claim by `domain:server#4` (6764534980; amendments 6766937041 and 6767013929). Client child G3 of epic #31527 (ADR-0150 D5). ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：客户端 SDK 的按名调用（`automation.*`、`actions.invoke` / `invokeGlobal`、`meta.getItem`，以及 `client.environment(id)` 上的同名方法）多了一个可选的 `namespace`。填了就发服务端已经在读的带包地址；不填时，发出的请求和改前逐字节相同。 - 为什么改：两个包装了同名的流程、动作或元数据项时，服务端已能按包寻址，并对歧义回 409，但 SDK 说不出要哪个包，只能吃 409。现在调用方能点名包；`actions.invoke` 不抛错，409 的候选包列表也随结果带回。 - 风险与回滚：纯加法。24 个调用逐条比对，不传 namespace 时 URL 与改前相同。传了 namespace、但路由会把路径读成另一个请求的组合（命名空间不合法、撞门的字面段、名字撞子资源段），在本地以 400 VALIDATION_ERROR 拒绝，不发请求。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/client/src/package-address.ts`（拒绝规则全在这里），然后 `packages/client/src/index.ts` 中 `actions.invoke` 的 catch（把候选列表带回）和 `meta.getItem` 的 URL 拼接。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/client exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-addressing.test.ts`，预期 79 条全过。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **`packages/client/src/package-address.ts` (new)**: the qualifier of a by-name call, written once. Each helper returns `''` for the bare call or `/` to insert after the door's prefix: - `automationFlowQualifier(name, address)` for `/automation/:ns/:name[/…]`, `automationTriggerQualifier` for `/automation/trigger/:ns/:name`, `actionsQualifier` for `/actions/:ns/:object/:action`, and `metaItemQualifier(type, name, address)` for `/meta/:type/:ns/:name`. - The namespace grammar, `_env` and each door's literal segments come from `@objectstack/spec/kernel` (`NAMESPACE_PATTERN`, `ENVIRONMENT_ADDRESS_SEGMENT`, `NAMESPACE_POSITION_LITERALS`). The two sub-resource sets, which no spec constant spells, are held equal to the server's own by a test. - `addressCandidatesOf(error)` reads `details.candidates` off an error the fetch layer threw. - **Refused before any request** (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, `httpStatus: 400`, nothing sent), because the router would read the qualified path as a different request (D5's order: literals, then `_env`, then an installed namespace, else bare): - a namespace outside `NAMESPACE_PATTERN`, other than `_env`; - a namespace that spells one of the door's literals (`trigger`, `hooks` on `/automation`; `global` on `/actions`); - a flow named like a flow sub-resource (`clone`, `runs`, `toggle`, `trigger`) under a package namespace, where `/automation/crm/runs` is the runs of the flow `crm` (seat ruling Q1 = A on #31691). Under `_env` the door reads it as a name, so it is sent; - a flow named like an `/automation` literal under any qualifier, `_env` included; - a metadata item named like a `/meta` sub-resource (`history`, `tree`, …), under any qualifier. It is read with `packageId` instead. - **`packages/client/src/index.ts`**: - `meta.getItem(type, name, { packageId?, namespace? })` builds `/meta/:type/:ns/:name`. Sending both is left to the door, which refuses it with 400 (pinned). - The unscoped `automation.trigger`, `get`, `update`, `delete`, `toggle`, `clone`, `runs.get`, `getFlow`, `execute`, `getRun`, `resume` and `getScreen` take a trailing `address?: { namespace }`; `runs.list` and `listRuns` take `namespace` in their options. - `actions.invoke` / `invokeGlobal` take `namespace` beside `recordId` and `params`, and return the new exported `ActionInvokeResult`, which adds `candidates?: readonly PackageScopedHolder[]`: a `409` keeps its holders on the result, since this surface never throws. - The scoped twins (`meta.getItem`, `automation.getFlow`, `execute`, `listRuns`, `getRun`, `resume`, `getScreen`) take the same. - Exported type: `QualifiedAddressOptions`. - **Route ledgers** (claim amendment 6767013929, asked by the epic red-line review 6766975502): the ADR-0150 D5 qualified rows said "server-only: the SDK names no namespace yet", which this PR makes false. The fifteen rows an SDK method now builds take `disposition: 'sdk'` and the bare row's `client`: eleven `/automation` rows in `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` (`get`, `update`, `delete`, `execute`, `toggle`, `clone`, `listRuns`, `getRun`, `resume`, `getScreen`, and the legacy `trigger`), the runtime and REST (`packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`) `GET /meta/:type/:ns/:name` rows (`meta.getItem`), and the two `/actions` rows (`invoke`, `invokeGlobal`). The addressed cancel and restore-suspension rows stay `server-only`, like their bare rows, and say the SDK has no method for them. The ledgers are test inputs only (not in either package's `dist`), so no runtime or REST changeset. - **Docs**: `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` gains "Addressing an item by its package". - **Changeset**: `@objectstack/client` patch. ## Tests `packages/client/src/package-addressing.test.ts` (new, 79 tests): 1. **Without a namespace, byte-for-byte today's.** A table of 24 calls (every method above, unscoped and scoped) asserts the literal method + URL with no address and with `{ namespace: undefined }`. `packageId` alone still reads `?package=` on the bare path. 2. **With a namespace, the qualified path a server ledger declares.** Each of the 24 asserts its literal qualified URL, and that a `:ns` row of the runtime route ledger or the REST route ledger matches it. `_env` on every door; a flow named `runs` under `_env` is sent; the action body is unchanged by the address. 3. **Refusals.** Each asserts `code` + `httpStatus` (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, 400) and zero requests: malformed namespaces (`Crm`, `c`, `''`, 21 characters), literal namespaces (`trigger`, `hooks`), sub-resource flow names, a door literal under `_env`, `/meta` sub-resource names (also under `_env`), and the scoped twins. `actions.invoke` with `global` / `Bad` returns `success: false` with zero requests. CONTROL: `runs_digest` under the same namespace is sent. Two pins hold the client's sub-resource sets equal to the metadata protocol's `META_ITEM_SUBRESOURCE_SEGMENTS` and to the `/automation/:name/` rows of the runtime route ledger. 4. **The real doors.** The client's fetch is bridged to `HttpDispatcher` (`handleAutomation`, `handleActions`, `handleMetadata`): - **4a `/automation`**: a namespace whose package holds no such flow while another does → rejects 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details.candidates` = the holder, nothing run. A bare two-holder name → 409 naming both, on the run and the read. CONTROL: the namespace's one holder is run and read. - **4b `/actions`**: a namespace two packages co-own, both declaring the name → `success: false` with both `candidates`, nothing run. CONTROL: each holder of a two-holder name is run by its namespace, with its own handler. CONTROL: a 404 carries no candidates. - **4c `/meta`** (real `SchemaRegistry` + `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`): each holder of a two-holder page is read by its namespace. A namespace holding nothing of a one-holder name → 409 whose message names the holder, while the bare read of that name is served (CONTROL). A bare two-holder read → 409 naming both. Both qualifiers → the door's 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`. - **Forced test change**: `envelope-caller-census.test.ts` counts every `automation.trigger` call site. The new file's three are classified `RESULT_INSENSITIVE` (URL and which-flow-ran reads only), and the census totals move 28 → 31 (32 with the recorded objectui site). - **Forced ledger change**: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` records the new pinned `findOne` double of the `/actions` door (`check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`, 1 row added, 0 lost). Claim amendment 6766937041 covers it. ## Acceptance notes - **The `/meta` 409 carries no `details.candidates`.** Measured on the wire through the real dispatcher: `/automation` and `/actions` send `details.candidates`; `/meta` (both transports answer through `thrownAnswerOf`) names the holders in the message only. So on `meta.getItem` the candidate list surfaces in the message, and `err.details?.candidates` is `undefined`. Making it structured needs a server door change, outside this claim (`never a server door`); it is card #32201. - **Calls left without a namespace (deviations)**: `meta.getHistory`, `getReferences`, `getAudit` and `diffItem`, because their server routes read no package. `automation.create` has no qualified form (the name is in the body of `POST /automation`). The catalogs (`listActions`, `listConnectors`, `getRuntimeStatus`) are not by name. The client has no method for the qualified connector-connection, inbound-hook or run cancel/restore doors, so nothing was added there. - **A well-formed namespace that no package declares** is the server's to judge: per the runtime route ledger, the door then reads the bare grammar.
